## Summary

A short description of the accessibility barrier.

## Who is affected

Which users or assistive technologies are affected? For example: screen reader users, keyboard-only users, users with low vision using browser zoom, users of voice control software.

## Steps to reproduce

1. Open the page at '…'
2. Using '…' (describe your assistive technology or navigation method)
3. Navigate to '…'
4. Observe: '…'

## Expected behaviour

What the accessible behaviour should be.

## Actual behaviour

What currently happens. Include screenshots, screen reader output, or console messages where possible.

## Environment

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Browser and version | |
| Assistive technology and version | |
| Operating system | |

## WCAG criterion (if known)

For example: 1.1.1 Non-text Content, 2.1.1 Keyboard, 4.1.2 Name, Role, Value.

## Suggested fix (optional)

If you have an idea for how to fix the issue, describe it here. A code suggestion is welcome but not required.

## Additional context

Any other information that would help reproduce or fix the issue.
